_comment: Guard cases for scripts/e2e-guard.mjs. Each case: a project setup, one tool call (shell / edit / write / patch shorthand, turned into each agent's payload shape, or a raw payload), and the expected decision. via "hook" runs it through the real hooks.json command for each listed agent; otherwise the guard is called in-process. Placeholders: {HOME} {TMPDIR} {STATE} {ALLOWED} {OUTSIDE} {PROJECT} {MACHINE} {TOKEN} {AWS} {PLUGIN}. {TOKEN} is a fake GitHub token made at run time; no secret is ever stored here.

I1 Codex's python3 here-document that turns protected-branches off

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
p = Path('.cartwright/settings.json')
s = json.loads(p.read_text())
s['guardrails']['protected-branches'] = False
p.write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2) + '\n')
PY
